"CASH SCRATCH FEVER" is new from the Georgia Lottery. It is a $5 game with three top prizes of $400,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

If "CASH SCRATCH FEVER" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
1927.headline: Brand new, no claims yet

1929.body:
On "Cheers 2027", one $20,027 top prize was claimed yesterday. That leaves fifteen of the original seventeen. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

If you play "Cheers 2027" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
